request: 한눈에 보는 시간표에서 일정안에있는 글씨위치 , 글씨크기 , 글씨체 고급지면서 디자인톤에 맞게 전부개선해줘
finalPrompt:
Create a refined typography and text-placement concept for the Korean TripLOG report section “한눈에 보는 시간표”. Show a complete three-day timetable on a white A4 portrait page, designed at approximately 794 × 1123 CSS pixels. Retain TripLOG’s dark navy text, pastel pink, pale blue and pale yellow event blocks, and small hand-drawn travel illustrations.

Focus on the text inside the event blocks. Use clear Pretendard-style Korean sans-serif typography. Give each event a calm visual hierarchy: a small medium-weight time range, a larger semibold place name, and a smaller secondary transport hint. Align text to consistent left insets with deliberate spacing. Short events use a compact single line for time and place. Medium events place time above the place name, with the illustration reserved on the right. Tall events keep time and place at the upper left, a concise transport hint near the lower left, and the illustration at the lower right. Keep text and illustrations in separate areas.

The timetable has three approximately 210px-wide day columns and an hourly axis from 08:00 to 20:00. Preserve time-proportional placement and varied block heights. The typography should feel polished, restrained and readable while retaining the friendly TripLOG design tone.

Use the report text “TripLOG”, “순천의 사흘”, “2026.10.09 – 10.11 · 2명”, and “한눈에 보는 시간표”.

DAY 1 · 10.09 (금): “10:30–10:50 순천역”, “11:00–16:00 순천만국가정원”, “18:00 순천 호텔”.
DAY 2 · 10.10 (토): “09:30–11:30 낙안읍성”, “12:30–14:00 감성 카페”, “16:00–18:00 순천만습지”.
DAY 3 · 10.11 (일): “09:30–10:30 중앙시장”, “11:30–13:00 죽도봉”, “14:00–14:30 순천역”.

Where space permits, use “🚗 15분” as the secondary transport hint on events after the first stop. Keep the existing timetable format and information hierarchy.
implementationScope: Typography and text placement inside timetable event blocks; retain actual trip content, time-proportional geometry, existing brand assets and activity illustrations.
